plugins.name: my-business-brain
plugins.description: Your business's trusted memory and Chief of Staff, in English and Arabic, kept as plain files in your own folder: sourced facts, a record of every change, its own identity, specialist agents it briefs and checks, promises tracked, a morning brief and Sunday review, and contract deadlines on your calendar. It prepares; you approve.
